description: Leader turns that a Council entry started (`request_kind` `council`). `agents` are the agent rows of the leader `lead`. The gateway gives `council.note` only when the entry author is an agent whose `parent_id` is the session of the turn: one plain-text line, `ROLE | title: text`. ROLE is the agent role in capitals, left out with its ` | ` when the agent has no role; title is the agent title, else `#n`, its start order in its team. text is the agent status of a host outcome entry (`source` `host`, `title` `Subagent result`, content `Subagent <author> — <status>\n…`), else the first non-blank line of the entry: whitespace runs become one space, inline Markdown markers go away except the backticks of inline code, a link or image keeps its text, a heading or list marker goes away. A note of more than 120 code points, label included, keeps 119 and ends with `…`. A client shows the note as plain text in one row, under the Council label, and keeps `council.content` for copy and detail. A turn without a note shows the full entry under the Council label, never as a person's message. One turn can take several Council entries that came together: then `council.entries` lists all of them in arrival order (at least two), the other `council` fields are those of the first entry, and the note is the note of the first entry with ` (+N more)`, where N counts the other entries; the 120 code point limit includes this suffix, and a clipped note ends with `…` before it. A client copies and shows the contents of all `council.entries`, joined by a blank line.
